BiblicalUsage: Relenting is what God says He will not do. He promises to ransom from the grave and redeem from death, and then adds that repentance shall be hid from His eyes — no turning back, no softening of what He has said.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's word holds both ways: He will ransom, and He will not relent from the judgment He has spoken.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
